resources.string: Sends your Health Connect data (activity, heart, sleep, workouts, cycle…) to your BodyLens server every hour.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. Install or update it from Google Play.
Open Health Connect in Google Play

Easiest: on this phone, open BodyLens → Your account → Data sources and tap \"Set up BodyLens Bridge\"; it fills this in for you. Or copy the address from there. It contains a secret key: do not share it.
Allow \"read data in the background\" too, so the hourly sending works with the app closed.
✓ Linked to your BodyLens account. Allow the permissions and the app sends your data every hour on its own.
Your BodyLens server: the address you open BodyLens at in the browser.
No BodyLens server answers at that address. Check it and your connection.
Then sign in with your BodyLens username and password, or create an account. You can change the server later in Your account.
Cannot connect to the BodyLens server. Check your connection.
